text:
anna_docs: opened a small docs PR to tighten up the Optimize toolkit migration guide. Adds: a short checklist, compatibility mapping for old quant_profile names, two SDK variants (low-latency vs throughput), and a note about streaming + KV prefetch interaction. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3498

devbot: PR #3498 opened by anna_docs  labels: docs, optkit, needs-review

mike_eng: thanks — will review. quick question though: are we renaming legacy quant profiles or aliasing them? breaking change for customers would be bad.

anna_docs: not breaking. added a mapping table and a tiny sed helper to update old deployment files if customers want to rename: `sed -i "s/quant_profile: q8_0/quant_profile: q8_0_compat/g" **/*.yaml`

sanjay_opt: good. also wondering about KV prefetch guidance — for very short sequences prefetch overhead hurts. we should show a short-turn snippet (dialog) with `batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False`.

anna_docs: done. added two labeled SDK examples under "Quickstart snippets":
```python
# low-latency (short-turn dialog)
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
client.configure(profile="low-latency", batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False, quant_profile="q8_0_compat")
resp = client.generate("User: Hi\nBot:")
```
```python
# throughput (cost-optimized)
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
client.configure(profile="throughput", batch_size=64, prefetch_kv=True, quant_profile="q8_0_compat")
resp = client.batch_generate(["Summarize: ..."] * 32)
```

lisa_pm: tiny product ask: step 3 links to the old Console page  can you point it to /console/telemetry and call out that rollouts respect profile aliases? left an inline comment.

devbot: staging deploy started for refs/heads/docs/pr-3498  preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optkit/migration

devbot: CI results: docs-lint  pass, link-check  fail (1 broken Console link)  see lisa_pm comment

anna_docs: fixed the Console URL to /console/telemetry, rebased, pushed. also added a short paragraph under "When to disable KV prefetch" with microbenchmark pointers. pasted smoke logs below for quick reference:
```
[smoke] profile=low-latency seq=16 tokens/s=150 p50=30ms
[smoke] profile=throughput seq=256 tokens/s=510 p50=115ms
[smoke] profile=prefetch-heavy seq=8 tokens/s=95 p50=60ms
```

sanjay_opt: ran quick GPU test: enabling prefetch gives +3.5x throughput on seq >= 128, but for seq < 32 p50 increases ~2x. I added a one-line heuristic: "Disable kv prefetch for typical short-turn dialog (seq < 48) to keep p50 low."

mike_eng: LGTM from infra. snippets are clear. one tiny nit I left inline re: wording around "compat" suffix.

lisa_pm: LGTM from PM side once CI passes. please include a one-line changelog entry for the release notes.

anna_docs: CI green, link-check passed. merging in 2m. will post a release-note bullet and ping support to watch for migration questions. :tada:

mike_eng: thanks all. this should cut the number of prefetch-related tickets we see.

anna_docs: merged. follow-up: I'll open a short tickets doc to log any field reports in the next 48h and add an FAQ blurb about streaming + prefetch.
